business_problem: process every customer signal at massive scale so marketing AI could personalize campaigns better than human audience selection without capping data volume.
solution_summary: Optimove uses Snowflake, Cortex AI, and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to process every customer signal at massive scale so marketing ai could personalize campaigns better than human audience selection without capping data volume. Behavioral histories, campaign interactions, and real-time customer events from more than 500 brands are processed on Snowflake at billion-row scale. Optimove uses the Snowflake foundation for large-scale AI audience selection and personalization, and keeps those models close to the data so it can score full histories instead of sampled subsets. The outputs feed campaign targeting and loyalty workflows for brand customers, giving marketers better audience selection and faster analytics without artificial limits on incoming data. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces copying, simplifies administration, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data for analytics, reporting, and AI.
